# Get Into Robotics

> Get Into Robotics (getintorobotics.com) is a curated robotics learning library by Akshet Patel. It organises open-source robotics projects, learning repositories, ROS and ROS 2 materials, YouTube channels, university courses, books and robotic simulators for beginners through advanced practitioners.

The site helps learners answer: where to start in robotics, which ROS or ROS 2 tutorials to follow, which simulators to try, and which university courses or books are freely available online.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://getintorobotics.com/): Overview of the library, search, and all curated collections
- [About](https://getintorobotics.com/about/): Editor, curation approach and trust information
- [FAQ](https://getintorobotics.com/faq/): Common questions about learning robotics and using this library

## Guides

- [How to learn robotics](https://getintorobotics.com/guides/how-to-learn-robotics/): Practical path from fundamentals to projects
- [Getting started with ROS 2](https://getintorobotics.com/guides/getting-started-with-ros-2/): First steps for ROS 2 learners
